The prophets employed this metallurgical image powerfully: Isaiah declares that Jerusalem's silver has become dross (Isa 1:22), and Ezekiel pictures the whole house of Israel as dross in God's furnace (Ezek 22:18-19). Proverbs uses it both literally, describing the removal of dross to purify silver (Prov 25:4), and figuratively, comparing insincere words to a potsherd glazed with silver dross (Prov 26:23). Spanish 'escoria' and French 'scorie' preserve the same smelting imagery found across ancient and modern languages."
